plan.failureSummary: Cached replay failed to locate 'Last Name' input field because the survey form rendered a different layout/set of fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred directly inside the cached replay execution (tests/.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js).
Live failure screenshot shows fields 'Your Name' and 'Contact Email' (Set 2), while cached instructions expected 'Last Name *' and '[data-testid="input-lastname"]'.
Test is not a retry attempt (isRetryAttempt: false) and ran in DETERMINISTIC mode.
The test objective is semantically flexible: complete all questions with fake data through to submission.

remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) and re-run the test autonomously so page.ai interacts with the active form variation.

remediationSteps.summary: Assess dynamic layout strategy if replay instability continues
remediationSteps.details: If dynamic variation across runs causes frequent deterministic replay failures, consider configuring this flow to run autonomously or handling variations gracefully.

additionalDataRequests.description: Compare the cached instructions with the dynamic form variants generated by the survey application.
suggestedSources: Donobu tool call history and screenshots

plan.notes: The survey app intentionally shifts layouts and field identifiers between loads. Replaying a deterministic cache keyed to a previous variation failed on the first input step. Clearing the Page.AI cache and running autonomously will allow the agent to adapt to the current form state.
